items.note: Lemon hero band with a 96px headline ringed by five different stickers (parcel, tag, button, ticket, receipt) of about 150–260px. Each is cropped by one side edge or the bottom seam and has a visible side strip, so this is clearly the reference's poster language. The hero action is a compact pink button with no bordered search beside it, where the reference pairs a big block CTA with a search field. The card grid of ink-framed white cards with band-ground vignettes and pink price flags is close in craft.

The hero holds up on a phone: four side-cropped stickers at about 150px around a large headline and a full-width pink CTA, much like the reference's mobile marigold band. Below it, the filter box sprawls. Pills wrap into two loose rows with big vertical gaps, and the sort select sits half-width. The reference stacks its filter box as tight 56px ruled rows.

This matches the reference's dark recipe: black bar, white current pill, pink cart block, and a lemon hero with its stickers unchanged. The filter box sits on a raised dark tone with a light hairline above the black ground. It shares the light version's small hero action without a search field.

Black bar with a pink cart block, an unchanged lemon hero with side-cropped stickers, and a raised dark filter panel. The dark depth is right. As in light, the filter panel's wrapped pills and half-width sort row are looser than the reference's ruled filter stack.

Lemon header band with breadcrumb and title, a pink flag, ink-framed options and a ruled details box: the chrome is right. The large media drawing is still a white outline with a side edge only a few pixels deep on a roughly 270px object, so it reads as a flat line drawing next to the reference's chunky die-cut objects. The disabled stepper is a grey-filled box, and the selected option is marked with a radio dot instead of a check disc.

Stacked header band, square lemon media box, then the flag and copy. The order and spacing are sound. The tote drawing is now kept inside its frame with a heavier outline, but it still has a sliver of side edge rather than the reference's solid sticker rim.

The dark chrome is right: white current pill, pink cart block, raised option boxes, and an unchanged lemon band and media ground. The lemon header band meets the black ground with no ink seam, and the large drawing has the same flat, thin-rimmed build as in light.

On a phone in dark, the lemon header band runs straight into the black ground with no seam. The lemon media box has lost its visible ink frame, and the tote is still a thin-rimmed outline. The rest of the chrome follows the reference's dark inversion.

Same strong product chrome on a marigold media ground. The sweater has a heavier outer stroke but no real back or side strip, so at about 360px it reads as an outlined flat garment, not a die-cut sticker. The grey disabled stepper and the radio-dot selection repeat the earlier state gap.

The breadcrumb wraps onto two lines in the band, but the hierarchy is clear: title, media, flag, copy. The sweater keeps its thick outline inside the frame but stays a flat shape with no side strip, unlike the reference's thick objects.
Correct dark inversion on the chrome, with raised option boxes, a raised stepper and the details box. The band has no ink seam onto the black ground, and the media drawing is as flat as in light.

Dark phone layout consistent with the tote page: unchanged band and media colours on black, but no seam under the band and a flat, thin-rimmed garment drawing where the reference would show a chunky sticker.

Periwinkle area band for the cart, then a dashed white empty box with a teal basket sticker, one sentence and a plate-stack CTA. This is the reference's empty-state recipe, close in feel to its dashed 'no products' box but richer. At rest the lemon plate shows as a strip above the button instead of hiding behind it, and the basket's side strip is shallow.

The band, dashed empty box and basket sticker scale well to the phone, with a full-width plate-stack CTA. The lemon plate again peeks above the button at rest, which reads like a misprint, not the reference's clean stack.

The periwinkle band stays unchanged and the empty box goes to a raised dark tone with a dashed light edge. The sticker sits on the raised field as the spec asks. Same plate strip above the CTA at rest.
Correct dark depth, with a raised dashed box on black and a pink cart block in the bar. Footer seam present. It shares the visible lemon plate edge above the CTA at rest.

findings.summary: Large item drawings on the product detail page are still flat outlines. The outer stroke is heavier now and the frame no longer cuts the object, but the back and side strip show only a few pixels on a 270–360px object, well under the 10% the spec asks for. The reference's objects are chunky die-cut card with a deep solid rim at every size, so the page's biggest image reads as a line drawing, not a sticker. This gap from the earlier verdict has only partly closed.
findings.promptFix: A drawing in a large media box is checked in rendered pixels, not viewBox units. Measure the solid strip between the face and the back on screen: it must be at least 10% of the drawing's rendered height (about 30px on a 300px object). Irregular shapes such as garments and bags have no single straight lower edge, so draw the back as the whole silhouette shifted down along the object's axis, and fill the gap between them as one solid region of the same fill. Never leave only a doubled outline line. If the strip reads as a thin second line, push the back lower until a band of colour clearly shows.

findings.summary: The front-page hero's action is a compact pink button on its own, about 160×48. The reference anchors its hero with a large block CTA paired with a bordered search field of the same height, so the action row weighs against the 96px headline. Here the action looks small under the headline and the sticker ring.

On phones, the catalog filter box wraps its pills into two loose rows with large gaps and leaves the sort select at about 70% width. The reference stacks phone filters as one ink box of full-width 56px ruled rows.

On the buy panel, the selected option is still a pink border with a radio dot, with no check disc, and the disabled stepper button is a grey-filled box. The reference marks selection with a pink border and a check disc on white, and never uses a grey fill. This is still open from the earlier verdict.
On the empty cart, the plate-stack CTA shows a strip of the lemon plate above the button at rest. The stack should sit hidden behind the button and fan out only on hover.

In dark mode on product pages, the lemon header band meets the black ground with no ink seam. On phones the media box also loses its visible ink frame. The reference closes every colour field with a visible seam in both modes.
